info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Methods-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods Retrieval API provides businesses with the functionality to access and list available payment methods for processing transactions. This endpoint serves as a resource for developers seeking to offer users various payment options during the checkout process, enhancing user experience and flexibility. Common consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, financial applications, and digital wallets that need to integrate diverse payment solutions. With this API, stakeholders can effectively manage and display payment method options tailored to their specific business needs.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve a list of available payment methods for transactions. It provides information about the types of payment methods that are supported and can be used during the payment process.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving payment methods. This body should be sent with any necessary parameters to correctly filter or specify the type of payment methods to be returned.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsRequest.title: Payments Methods GET Request Body
ListPaymentsPaymentsMethodsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation on payment methods. It is expected to be a string that may contain payment method identifiers.
